tests.name: test_upgrade_follows_install_order_and_waits_leaf
tests.doc: Upgrade patches a -> b -> parent, each after the previous is ready again; helm finishes after the leaf is ready.

tests.name: test_uninstall_reverse_order_for_ordered_install
tests.doc: Uninstall of a sequenced release deletes in exact reverse: parent -> b -> a, each after the previous is gone.

tests.name: test_uninstall_after_plain_install_is_not_sequenced
tests.doc: A release installed all at once (plain --wait, no stored plan) is uninstalled all at once.

tests.name: test_rollback_follows_target_revision_order
tests.doc: Rollback to a sequenced revision re-applies it in its order, then removes the extras in reverse (d before c).

tests.name: test_failure_stops_install_dependent_never_applied
tests.doc: A dependency that never becomes ready fails the install; its dependent is never applied; the release is failed.

tests.name: test_rollback_on_failure_cleans_up
tests.doc: --rollback-on-failure: the install fails, then Helm deletes what it applied and leaves no release.

tests.name: test_readiness_timeout_per_batch_cap
tests.doc: --readiness-timeout 10s under --timeout 2m fails the never-ready batch after ~10s, not 1m or 2m.

tests.name: test_readiness_timeout_exceeds_timeout_rejected
tests.doc: --readiness-timeout 3m --timeout 2m: rejected immediately, nothing applied.

observations.label: error message
observations.value: Error: INSTALLATION FAILED: --readiness-timeout (3m0s) must not exceed --timeout (2m0s)

tests.name: test_default_readiness_timeout_one_minute
tests.doc: No --readiness-timeout, --timeout 3m: fails after ~60s (default 1m readiness timeout).

tests.name: test_hooks_not_sequenced_run_by_weight
tests.doc: Hooks run before chart resources in hook-weight order, outside the plan, despite sequencing annotations.

tests.name: test_plain_wait_applies_everything_at_once
tests.doc: --wait applies all four Deployments together; at least one dependent before dependency ready.

tests.name: test_independent_subcharts_deploy_together
tests.doc: nginx and rabbitmq (no mutual dependency) applied together before either is ready.

tests.name: test_subcharts_dag_order_and_gating
tests.doc: bar waits for nginx+rabbitmq ready; foo waits for bar ready.

tests.name: test_release_record_has_plan_when_sequenced
tests.doc: Ordered install has plan with batches; plain --wait has no plan.

tests.name: test_subchart_alias_dependency
tests.doc: zeta with alias z-service; alpha depends on both alias and original name; order respected.

tests.name: test_nested_subcharts_three_levels
tests.doc: grandchild-a → child-b → parent-z; each level applied after the level below is ready.
